$comment: A local model, for work that must not leave the machine. Ollama serves it on localhost, so there is no provider account, no per-token cost and no network egress. Pull it first: `ollama pull qwen3-coder:30b`.
title: Qwen3 Coder 30B on Ollama (local)
notes: Runs on your machine. The model is about 19 GB on disk and needs a machine that can hold it; a laptop with less memory will swap and the loop will look broken rather than slow. Tool calling is supported, but it is weaker at long multi-step plans than the hosted models, so use it for locate/verify lanes and small builds first.
